title: Automated Code Generation of High-Order Stencils for a Dataflow Architecture
problem: Implementing high-order stencil computations on dataflow architectures requires careful management of data routing and memory constraints within severely limited memory footprints, making manual code development for these specialized processors difficult and time-consuming.
motivation: High-order stencil computations are critical for seismic simulations, weather forecasting, and computational fluid dynamics, and dataflow architectures like Cerebras' wafer-scale engine offer potential for significant acceleration.
method: The system automatically generates code to run high-order stencils (calculations that examine neighboring data values) on dataflow processors like the Cerebras wafer-scale engine. It automates the complex task of determining how to route data between processing units and coordinate their communication, optimizing for the processor's limited memory and routing capacity—constraints that would otherwise require manual code development.
key_novelty: The key idea is automating code generation for dataflow processors like the Cerebras wafer-scale engine to run high-order stencils, automatically solving the routing and memory constraint problems that normally require manual coding, while achieving performance comparable to hand-written code.
contributions: Framework for portable code generation of stencil computations on dataflow architectures
Code generation strategies for router configurations on Cerebras wafer-scale engine
Communication sequencing algorithms for high-order stencils on constrained dataflow platforms
Demonstration of 7x code size reduction versus hand-crafted CSL with comparable performance

metrics.other: 7x reduction in code size versus hand-crafted CSL
